confidence_notes: Numbeo's Bologna sample, updated October 2026, reports €20 for an inexpensive meal, €80 for a three-course meal for two, €6 draft beer, and €1.99 cappuccino. Expatistan reports an €8 cocktail, but its page says the price data came from 16 entries by fewer than five people. No restaurant wine-glass price was available, so that anchor is estimated near the local draft-beer price. Hostel averages vary and some exclude taxes and fees; hotel prices are availability-sensitive. The available price data postdates the July 2026 reference window.
comparable_city_reasoning: Direct Bologna price observations were available; no comparison city was used.
